description: This PHP class 'QueryParser' is part of the AWS SDK for PHP. It is responsible for parsing XML (query) responses from AWS services like EC2 and SQS. The class extends 'AbstractParser' and uses traits and other classes to process response bodies, extract relevant data, and produce Result objects.

classes.name: QueryParser
classes.description: A parser class for AWS query (XML) response bodies, handling result wrapping and XML parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the QueryParser with API service description, optional XML parser, and a flag to honor result wrappers.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method to parse the response body of an AWS command, returning a Result object.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses a specific structure shape from a stream response, returning the parsed data.
